title: Lenny Kravitz Brings His 007 Character Back for an Unexpected Crossover
summary: Lenny Kravitz's 007 First Light character will return in an exciting crossover event, and further details about the collaboration have been revealed The post Lenny Kravitz Brings His 007 Character Back for an Unexpected Crossover appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit - IO Interactive Lenny Kravitz ‘s 007 First Light character will return in an exciting crossover event, and further details about the collaboration have been revealed. IO Interactive has introduced Kravitz as Bawma in a new Elusive Target mission for Hitman World of Assassination . The character is playable from November 26 until December 24, 2026, for free as part of the Free Demo for new players and in the game for players who already own Hitman World of Assassination for a limited time. The new Elusive Target mission will feature Kravitz’s voiceover as the Pirate King Bawma. The Grammy winner shared in a recent statement, “Bawma is such a fun and interesting character to portray, so I was excited to step back into a new world with him for 007 First Light. Seeing Bawma team up with Agent 47 is something I think fans of both games are going to love.” In this latest mission, Agent 47 is deployed to Ambrose Island on the instruction of Bawma. After tracking him down through the island’s ruins and jungles, 47 realizes that the mission involves something far more valuable than a simple target. Three of Bawma’s rogue lieutenants stand guard over something they will not let go so easily. The new Elusive Target comes with more free content for Hitman players Players who own Hitman World of Assassination or have access to Ambrose Island and complete The Mutiny before its December 24 expiration will retain permanent access to the Arcade version of the mission and its Special Assignment for free. Additionally, the game is launching a brand-new roadmap, bringing fresh and returning content for players to enjoy. These include a new Elusive Target, a new Escalation, new Arcade and Special Assignment contracts, a new challenge, a batch of Featured Contracts, a new Twitch Drop, and an IOI Account reward. Two fan-favorite Elusive Targets and two seasonal events are also returning. As with all Elusive Targets, this mission will be removed from the game when it expires on December 24, 2026. title: Maddie Ziegler’s Netflix Christmas Movie Has Surprising Horror Roots
summary: Christina Lauren, the writing duo of Christina Hobbs and Lauren Billings, spoke with ComingSoon’s Tyler Treese about their book In a Holidaze becoming a Netflix movie starring Maddie Ziegler and Rob Lowe. They discussed the film’s unique time loop, how it was inspired by a horror movie, and more. It begins streaming on December 2, […] The post Maddie Ziegler’s Netflix Christmas Movie Has Surprising Horror Roots appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: (Photo Credit: Bettina Strauss/Netflix © 2026) Christina Lauren, the writing duo of Christina Hobbs and Lauren Billings, spoke with ComingSoon’s Tyler Treese about their book In a Holidaze becoming a Netflix movie starring Maddie Ziegler and Rob Lowe. They discussed the film’s unique time loop, how it was inspired by a horror movie, and more. It begins streaming on December 2, 2026. “After making a romantic mistake of epic proportions, a directionless twenty-something finds herself trapped in a holiday time-loop, forced to relive the same Christmas at her family’s cabin until she discovers what truly makes her happy,” says the official synopsis. Tyler Treese: Christina, I always love seeing if authors got to visit the set any. So did you get to actually check it out? Because the cabin is such a character in the story of In a Holidaze, so I can’t imagine what it was like if you got to see it brought to life. Christina Hobbs: Yes, we did get to visit the set. We were there for two days in March. And when we walked in, I immediately started crying because it was this huge cabin, life-size cabin, and it was so beautiful. It was every detail. As soon as I saw the Christmas tree and the stockings with their names on them, I just started crying. And the family photos up on the stairs, even the books on the shelf. There was a Danielle Steel book on the shelf, and it was just so perfectly curated. Yeah. Lauren, I was curious how it felt watching the film and seeing Mae brought to life by Maddie Ziegler. She’s so charismatic in this film. So how was it seeing this character that you two crafted brought to life on the screen? Lauren Billings: Yeah, I mean, she’s perfect. And it’s sort of indescribable because you write a character and you sort of have an idea of who they are, and that’s why when people ask us, “Who would you cast as this character in this book?” or whatever, we can’t really ever think of it because they’re their own person in our head. But she is Mae. She was perfect. She’s vulnerable. She’s loving. She’s loyal. She’s funny. She’s all of these things, and she captures that so perfectly. And also, Maddie is just a really, really wonderful human being. I don’t know, I feel so lucky that we got her for Mae because nobody else could have done it as well. Hobbs: Yeah, she is Mae. Billings: Yeah. Christina, I was interested in In a Holidaze because it’s a multiple-day time loop rather than just one repeating day, like Groundhog Day. What did you like most about that convention? Because we really get to see the ramifications of the actions, which I thought was really interesting. Christina Hobbs: Well, so everybody thinks that it’s like Groundhog Day, but really the inspiration came from Happy Death Day, which is one of our favorite movies. It’s so clever. And I love the thing that she can go a little bit further, and that’s how she knows, or she thinks that she knows, that she’s doing something right. It’s like, “Oh, I made it to the 22nd. I made it to the 23rd.” And they were able to do it so much better, I think, than we were in the book because we get to see her reaction, where in the book, we have to tell the reader everything that’s happening. They were so smart about how they did it. Lauren, we get introduced to a lot of characters right off the bat in In a Holidaze. I was a bit concerned about remembering everybody, but by the end, I was charmed and liked everybody. What’s most difficult when you have such an ensemble and making sure nobody seems unneeded and everybody has their little moments? Lauren Billings: Yeah, so we’ve written series where it started with one couple, and by the last book in the series, we have five couples, and everybody has their favorite, and the readers are gonna wanna see everybody on the same page. And it’s just really hard to manage. This book, because it felt like this chosen family was sort of the scaffold around Andrew and Mae’s love story, it didn’t feel hard to write because everybody kind of lent a different level of support to them as a couple. I think when we visited set, we hadn’t realized how hard that would be to manage from a production standpoint because it’s so many people on set. There’s like 11 cast members that are always together. But they did it so beautifully. I mean, I think that, like you said, you can be worried at the beginning that you’re not gonna be able to remember everybody, but everybody has such a distinct personality, and they’re so dimensional, and they’re so beautifully created and also acted, brought to life by these actors. I don’t know, I think that it’s done so perfectly. It’s really impressive. Thanks to Christina Lauren for taking the time to talk about In a Holidaze. summary: Daniel Radcliffe‘s latest animated fairy-tale adventure is finding a large audience on Netflix. The film puts a playful spin on the Cinderella story, giving its characters unexpected roles. With a star-packed voice cast and a kingdom in trouble, the movie offers fans a different kind of magical ride. content: Photo Credit: Paramount Pictures Daniel Radcliffe ‘s latest animated fairy-tale adventure is finding a large audience on Netflix . The film puts a playful spin on the Cinderella story, giving its characters unexpected roles. With a star-packed voice cast and a kingdom in trouble, the movie offers fans a different kind of magical ride. Steps claims No. 1 position on Netflix charts According to FlixPatrol , Steps has climbed to the top of Netflix’s U.S. Top 10 movies chart, moving ahead of titles such as Guarding Stars, Rob Lowe: The Outsider, All for Christmas, Insidious: Out of the Further, Obsession and Primetime Preacher$. Daniel Radcliffe voices Prince Charming, but the story gives the spotlight to Cinderella’s stepsisters, Lilith and Margot. Ali Wong voices Lilith, while Stephanie Hsu plays Margot. Amanda Seyfried lends her voice to Cinderella, and Bette Midler plays the Fairy Godmother. Nikki Glaser voices Priscilla, Peter Dinklage plays Roderick, and Young Mazino voices Gef. Damian Priest also joins the cast as Cracktor. Lilith is done playing second fiddle to Cinderella, so she makes a reckless grab for the Fairy Godmother’s wand. The stunt throws the royal ball into chaos and hands Priscilla the perfect chance to take control and chase after Prince Charming. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella to pull the kingdom out of the trouble. Their rescue mission brings them face-to-face with motorcycle-riding trolls, a menacing man-nanny and the nightmare-inducing Screaming Woods. Directors Alyce Tzue and John Ripa reshape the familiar tale around sisterhood and belonging. Tzue told TUDUM that she wanted to tell a story for people who “felt like they didn’t belong.” Wong also welcomed the chance to play someone driven by resentment. “I thought it was a fun challenge to play a character so full of resentment, who wasn’t born as some genetic masterpiece, and who had to work through all of that,” she said. Steps also has an 81% critics score on Rotten Tomatoes , a 74% audience score, and a 6.7 rating on IMDb . content: Photo Credit: Lionsgate / Universal Pictures Colman Domingo recently responded to criticism of his performance as Joe Jackson in the film Michael on X (formerly Twitter). The exchange began when a critic objected to the awards buzz that Domingo has received for his performance. Instead of a lengthy response, the actor replied with just three words. Michael actor responds to criticism of his Joe Jackson role Colman Domingo has reacted to criticism of his portrayal of Joe Jackson in Michael after a social media user questioned whether his performance deserves awards season recognition. The actor addressed the comment on X, responding directly to the user’s comments about both his acting and the film overall. The exchange took place on Wednesday, November 25, as Domingo’s name continued to feature in predictions for the upcoming awards season. The criticism came from X user Wilfred Okiche, who wrote, “Awards prognosticators adding Colman Domingo for Michael, you really don’t need to add a mid performance/bad movie. You really don’t.” Domingo simply responded by asking, “Who hurt you?” Notably, Okiche’s profile on the social media platform states that he is a member of the Critics Choice Association. Who hurt you? — Colman Domingo (@colmandomingo) November 25, 2026 Domingo plays Joe Jackson, the father of Michael Jackson, in the biographical film Michael, while Jaafar Jackson takes on the role of the legendary singer. Nia Long also appears in the film as Katherine Jackson, and Miles Teller stars as Michael Jackson’s attorney, John Branca. Since the film’s theatrical release and worldwide box office success, Domingo’s performance has received attention from critics ahead of awards season. Released in April, Michael has achieved considerable commercial success. However, the film’s awards campaign has not included every major ceremony, as reported by Variety . Michael was not submitted for the 2027 BAFTA Film Awards, while the Golden Globes has categorized it as a drama instead of a comedy or musical. summary: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova writer Dave Callaham recently shared his thoughts on how the MonsterVerse has changed since his first involvement with the franchise. Comparing the 2014 film Godzilla with the upcoming sequel, he noted the significant shift in the series’ approach. His comments also reveal how different the creative process was when he returned […] The post Godzilla x Kong: Supernova Writer’s Blunt Take on Realism May Divide MonsterVerse Fans appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit: Warner Bros. Pictures Godzilla x Kong: Supernova writer Dave Callaham recently shared his thoughts on how the MonsterVerse has changed since his first involvement with the franchise. Comparing the 2014 film Godzilla with the upcoming sequel, he noted the significant shift in the series’ approach. His comments also reveal how different the creative process was when he returned to write the latest chapter. Dave Callaham compares his two MonsterVerse experiences Dave Callaham has described how his approach to the MonsterVerse changed between his work on the 2014 Godzilla film and the upcoming Godzilla x Kong: Supernova. The screenwriter discussed the contrast between the projects during an appearance on the Escape Hatch podcast , explaining that his return to the franchise was a very different creative experience from his first time working on it. Callaham spoke about writing Godzilla x Kong: Supernova, the next chapter in the MonsterVerse franchise, and expressed satisfaction with the finished script. “I also wrote next year’s Godzilla Kong installment. It’s called Godzilla x Kong: Supernova. Which I think is pretty good for one of those movies. Make of that what you will, I’m pretty happy about it,” he said. He then reflected on the difference between the two MonsterVerse projects that he’s worked on, particularly the shift in how the franchise approaches realism. Callaham worked on the 2014 Godzilla, which aimed for a more realistic portrayal of the giant monster and the world around it. Returning to the series for Supernova meant adapting to a franchise that has since moved further away from that approach. “I had a real fun time coming back to the MonsterVerse after working on the 2014 movie, which we tried to make very realistic. And now, uh, those movies are not very realistic anymore, so that was a fun switch,” Callaham added. The upcoming film’s cast includes Kaitlyn Dever as Jesse Portman, Dan Stevens as Trapper, Jack O’Connell as John Portman, and Delroy Lindo as Conway. It is set to hit theaters on March 26, 2027. summary: Fans of Simon Pegg’s comedy films have received an exciting update from the actor in a recent interview. The news comes more than a decade after the last installment and could bring a fourth movie to the beloved Cornetto trilogy. In an interview with LADbible Ireland, Pegg was asked about the possibility of reuniting with […] The post Simon Pegg Sparks Hope for a Fourth Cornetto Movie After 13 Years appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit: Lionsgate Fans of Simon Pegg’s comedy films have received an exciting update from the actor in a recent interview. The news comes more than a decade after the last installment and could bring a fourth movie to the beloved Cornetto trilogy . In an interview with LADbible Ireland, Pegg was asked about the possibility of reuniting with Edgar Wright for a fourth movie. The actor confirmed that the project is in its early stages, saying, “It’s in the very, very early stages. Yeah. But, but yeah, absolutely.” View this post on Instagram Pegg further revealed, “Edgar and I are sort of talking about it at the moment. We’ve got a Zoom call tomorrow about, you know, we’re sort of fleshing out something at the moment.” However, the 56-year-old actor did not disclose any details about the potential fourth installment or its storyline. The Cornetto trilogy began with three films that became cult favorites The Three Flavors Cornetto trilogy began in 2004 with Shaun of the Dead, a horror comedy directed by Wright and co-written by him and Pegg. The film follows Pegg’s Shaun, an ordinary man whose life takes an unexpected turn when a zombie outbreak hits London. Alongside his best friend Ed, played by Nick Frost , Shaun struggles to protect his loved ones while navigating the chaos. The trilogy’s second film, Hot Fuzz, was released in 2007, shifting the focus from horror comedy to a police action comedy. Pegg stars as Nicholas Angel, a highly skilled London police officer who is transferred to the quiet village of Sandford. However, a series of suspicious deaths soon raises questions about the seemingly peaceful community. Frost plays Danny Butterman, Angel’s enthusiastic new partner. The trilogy concluded in 2013 with The World’s End, which shifted the focus to science fiction. Pegg stars as Gary King, a man who convinces his childhood friends to return to their hometown and complete a pub crawl they failed to finish in their youth. However, their reunion takes an unexpected turn when the group discovers that something strange has happened to the town’s residents. title: Tangled: Milo Manheim Shares His Chaotic Reaction to Landing Flynn Rider
summary: Milo Manheim recalls the unexpected moment he learned he would play Flynn Rider in Disney's live-action Tangled The post Tangled: Milo Manheim Shares His Chaotic Reaction to Landing Flynn Rider appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit - Apple TV Milo Manheim recalls the unexpected moment he learned he would play Flynn Rider in Disney ‘s live-action Tangled . The actor revealed that he had received the casting news shortly before the announcement went public. He also shared his immediate reaction and explained how excited he was to join the upcoming adaptation. In an interview with Entertainment Weekly , Manheim clarified that he had not been keeping the casting news a secret for months. He explained, “I found out 10 minutes before the news was released that I’d be playing Flynn.” He recalled, “My skin was like tingling that day,” and added that he felt “flooded with dopamine and love and everything.” View this post on Instagram Why playing Flynn Rider is such a dream come true for Milo Manheim Manheim’s excitement also comes from his connection to the original Disney film. The actor expressed his admiration for the animated film and emphasized that he wants to respect its legacy while stepping into Flynn’s shoes. He said, “I want to really honor this movie and this role.” Sharing his enthusiasm, Manheim added, “I love, I love Tangled, so here we go, adventure of a lifetime.” For Manheim, the opportunity is particularly meaningful because he gets to be part of a story he already loves. The actor will star opposite Teagan Croft , who will play Rapunzel. Kathryn Hahn will play Mother Gothel. Diego Luna has also joined the cast in a currently undisclosed role. Patrick and Hugo McPherson will portray the Stabbington brothers. Michael Gracey, who previously directed The Greatest Showman, is helming the live-action film. Jennifer Kaytin Robinson and Michael Montemayor are writing the screenplay, while Kristin Burr is producing the project. Lucy Kitada serves as an executive producer. Disney’s original Tangled premiered in 2010 and featured Mandy Moore as Rapunzel and Zachary Levi as Flynn Rider. The animated musical follows the pair as they embark on an adventure that takes Rapunzel beyond the tower where she has spent most of her life. The live-action Tangled will arrive in theaters on March 31, 2028. title: Dune: Part Three’s Reported Budget Sets New Benchmark for Villeneuve’s Sci-Fi Saga
summary: Denis Villeneuve’s Dune universe is getting one of its biggest productions yet The post Dune: Part Three’s Reported Budget Sets New Benchmark for Villeneuve’s Sci-Fi Saga appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit - Warner Bros. Pictures Denis Villeneuve ‘s Dune universe is getting one of its biggest productions yet. The reported price tag for Dune: Part Three puts the final chapter ahead of its two predecessors, making it the most expensive entry in his sci-fi saga. According to The New York Times , Legendary Entertainment and Warner Bros. reportedly spent about $200 million on the film’s production, excluding marketing. Dune: Part Three draws from Frank Herbert’s novel Dune Messiah and follows Paul Atreides after his rise to power. The story takes place nearly two decades after Dune: Part Two, with Timothée Chalamet returning as the emperor. Zendaya reprises her role as Chani, while Robert Pattinson joins the cast as a character plotting against Paul. Anya Taylor-Joy also returns as Alia. How does Dune: Part 3’s budget compare with previous Dune movies? The reported $200 million budget makes Dune: Part Three the most expensive film in Villeneuve’s trilogy. The 2021 Dune reportedly cost $165 million , while Dune: Part Two had a $190 million production budget. The new film is $35 million more expensive than the first movie and $10 million more expensive than the second. Its budget has grown by about 21% since the original film. The earlier movies also built a strong theatrical record for the franchise. According to The Numbers , Dune earned around $430 million worldwide. Dune: Part Two collected roughly $715 million globally, grossing about $285 million more than the first film. It also opened to $82.5 million in North America, more than double the original’s $41 million debut. Dune: Part Two earned more than three times its reported production budget worldwide, setting a strong box-office benchmark for the third film. Dune: Part Three is scheduled to arrive in theaters on December 18, 2026, alongside Avengers: Doomsday . Fans have nicknamed the double release DunesDay, just like Barbenheimer in 2023. title: Anthony Mackie Exposes the Surprising Twist Behind Eminem’s 8 Mile Battle
summary: Anthony Mackie looked back on 8 Mile, sharing an unexpected behind-the-scenes anecdote The post Anthony Mackie Exposes the Surprising Twist Behind Eminem’s 8 Mile Battle appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit - Universal Pictures Anthony Mackie looked back on 8 Mile, sharing an unexpected behind-the-scenes anecdote. The actor opened up about his breakthrough performance in the Eminem -led drama film. During a recent interview on the On Film…With Kevin McCarthy podcast, Mackie discussed how he developed his 8 Mile character Papa Doc with the film’s director Curtis Hanson. He recalled how Papa Doc initially appeared in only four scenes before Hanson helped expand the character throughout the movie. “He taught me a lot as far as working on film and developing a character,” Mackie said of Hanson. “He would sit me down, ’cause Papa Doc was only four scenes. After I finished my four scenes, he wasn’t in the initial rap battle. Like, he was in none of that.” Mackie went on to recall, “So Curtis was like, ‘Yo, do you have anything after this?’ I said, ‘No.’ He was like, ‘Well, I’m thinking about developing your character some more. Can you stay?’ I was like, ‘Hell yeah.'” The MCU star further explained, “After that, we just developed all that secondary stuff. Like, literally, Papa Doc would just show up, beat up Eminem, and leave. That was his whole thing. That was in three, maybe four scenes, and then we developed it out to where he is in the movie today. Like, that whole last rap battle was not there.” Anthony Mackie’s journey from 8 Mile to Hollywood stardom 8 Mile marked Anthony Mackie’s feature film debut, before landing his breakthrough role in the 2004 independent film Brother to Brother. The following year, he appeared in the Academy Award-winning film Million Dollar Baby. He went on to star in several notable films, including Half Nelson, The Hurt Locker, The Adjustment Bureau, and more. Mackie made his Marvel debut as Sam Wilson , also known as Falcon, in 2014’s Captain America: The Winter Soldier. He has since reprised the role in subsequent films and television series in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He officially took on the mantle of Captain America in the series The Falcon and the Winter Soldier. Anthony Mackie will next appear in Avengers: Doomsday, which will arrive in theaters on December 18, 2026. The film also includes language, teen drug use, […] The post Nicole Kidman & Osgood Perkins’ The Young People Gets a Gruesome MPA Rating appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit: Warner Bros. Entertainment Osgood Perkins is returning with another horror movie, and his upcoming project has already earned a gruesome rating. The Young People , starring Nicole Kidman , Lola Tung , and Nico Parker , has officially received an R rating from the MPA. The rating points to plenty of violence and gore. The film also includes language, teen drug use, and brief sexual material, adding to the mystery surrounding Perkins’ next horror project. The Young People brings Nicole Kidman into Osgood Perkins’ disturbing horror world Per the MPA’s official bulletin, The Young People is rated R for “strong bloody violence, gore, language, some teen drug use, and brief sexual material/nudity.” The film marks Perkins’ fourth consecutive horror feature with NEON in just a few years, following Longlegs, The Monkey and Keeper. Kidman joins an ensemble led by Lola Tung and Nico Parker. The cast also includes Tatiana Maslany, Brendan Hines, Cush Jumbo, Heather Graham, Johnny Knoxville, Lexi Minetree and Lily Collias. Plot details remain under wraps. However, an unconfirmed synopsis hints the story follows two school friends whose relationship turns sinister after one begins showing disturbing behavior. A script image shared by NEON also mentioned The Old Ones, sparking speculation about possible Lovecraftian influences. Tung recently described the film as a strange but exciting experience. She also said she felt scared on set at times, something she had not experienced before. Written and directed by Perkins, the film marks the first project under his first-look deal with NEON through his production company, Phobos. He is also producing the movie alongside Chris Ferguson and Brian Kavanaugh-Jones. NEON will distribute The Young People theatrically, although the film does not yet have an official release date. The studio is also overseeing international sales and co-financing the project alongside Lyrical Media. title: Sebastian Stan Has a Bold Response to Thunderbolts’ $382M Box Office Run
summary: Sebastian Stan considers Thunderbolts* a success despite its modest box office performance The post Sebastian Stan Has a Bold Response to Thunderbolts’ $382M Box Office Run appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit - Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures Sebastian Stan considers Thunderbolts* a success despite its modest box office performance. Released in 2025, the movie grossed $382 million worldwide. While the figure fell short of the billion-dollar grosses achieved by some Marvel releases, Stan believes the film was successful. Stan, known for his portrayal of Bucky Barnes in the MCU, noted that the feature’s financial numbers shouldn’t overshadow the effort and care the creative team put into it. Appearing in an interview with Matt Neglia of Next Best Picture, he said, “I think it’s just when you’ve had a studio, and you’ve had Marvel, and it’s been so many years where they’ve just been knocking it out of the park.” He added, “A $350 million global, I think it was, or something like that number, it just suddenly doesn’t seem that much, but it’s insane how much money that is, you know. I don’t know. I still felt like for us it felt like a success.” The deeper meaning behind Thunderbolts’ approach to mental health and depression Florence Pugh’s character, Yelena Belova, constantly tries to cope with grief, emptiness, and detachment by staying busy. Yelena tries to bottle up her pain and emotions instead of facing it. Bob Reynolds’ dark alter ego, The Void, acts as a literal manifestation of depression, shame, and unaddressed trauma. content: Photo Credit: Netflix A popular Netflix star now faces a civil lawsuit following allegations of a physical attack and online defamation. According to court filings, Ellie Fallon accuses the Tiny Pretty Things star of attacking her in a park last year and allegedly using anonymous Reddit posts to spread false claims about her modeling career and David Harbour ‘s marriage. However, the actress’s legal team has firmly denied the allegations. Casimere Jollette accused of spreading rumors about David Harbour According to the New York Post , New York Supreme Court documents reveal that Fallon claims Jollette approached her while she was sitting on a bench in Tribeca Park in December 2025. The filing alleges that the Netflix actress intentionally threw hot water at Fallon before repeatedly punching her. Fallon states in the complaint that the alleged altercation caused severe physical injuries requiring immediate medical attention. Furthermore, she claims the recovery process prevented her from working and generated significant medical bills. Alongside the physical allegations, the Casimere Jollette lawsuit accuses the actress of orchestrating an online smear campaign against the New York City model. As reported by TMZ, Fallon contends that Jollette authored now-deleted Reddit posts that falsely labeled her a “homewrecker” in the marriage between Stranger Things actor David Harbour and singer Lily Allen. Previously, fans and media outlets had speculated about a potential romance between Harbour and Fallon following his breakup with Allen. However, neither Harbour nor Fallon has confirmed a romantic relationship. The civil suit further alleges that the anonymous Reddit posts—which Fallon attributes to Jollette—disparaged her professional modeling career by claiming she had never worked with a legitimate agency. Fallon maintains that all statements made in the initial post and a subsequent January follow-up post are entirely false. However, according to the New York Post, the lawsuit does not explain how the Reddit posts were attributed to Jollette. Jollette’s legal team has firmly pushed back against the civil lawsuit. Her attorney, Bill McGovern, rejected the accusations , asserting that the filing has “no merit.” Bill expressed confidence that the court will throw the case out immediately. McGovern noted that Fallon previously pursued a criminal case against Jollette over the same allegations, which the court dismissed. Additionally, the Manhattan District Attorney’s Office confirmed to the New York Post that the court sealed the record. content: Photo Credit: CBS A major shakeup is underway at a prominent CBS -owned station, as a beloved veteran anchor and three other journalists prepare to step down. Following more than four decades at WJZ-TV, the seasoned broadcaster is reportedly departing alongside three colleagues. These exits follow Skydance’s October acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, which prompted widespread buyouts across CBS stations amid ongoing cost-cutting. Veteran anchor among four journalists reportedly leaving CBS News station Denise Koch has been a part of WJZ-TV since 1981 as an anchor and news reporter. However, she will say goodbye to the station alongside three other journalists. According to a Banner report , she accepted the voluntary buyouts that were offered to all CBS stations. According to a statement, employees across the company were eligible for the buyouts. They stated that further decisions regarding the buyouts will be discussed in the newsroom at the right time. In addition, meteorologist Tim Williams, anchor Amy Kawata, and investigative reporter Mike Hellgren will also be departing the news stations. At the time of writing, neither Koch nor the other reporters have officially addressed their exit. Koch completed her Bachelor of Arts and Masters Degree in Theatre Arts from the University of California and later joined the CBS News station. Her journalism career has been graced with several honors, including an Emmy and the Edward R. Murrow Award. She received the latter award for her coverage of the Francis Scott Key Bridge collapse. In 2022, in a video celebrating her 40th anniversary at the station, Koch opened up about never having thought she would remain there for so many years. This is because, when she accepted the offer, she didn’t think she would be with the station for more than a year. “It was never a plan. Life just kept making sense, and I just kept really loving and enjoying where I lived and what I was doing,” she continued. content: Photo Credit: Facebook Watch One of Elizabeth Olsen ‘s most acclaimed dramas is getting another chance to find viewers. The series arrives on Netflix just after the release of Avengers: Doomsday , giving audiences a fresh opportunity to catch one of the actor’s earlier television performances. Sorry for Your Loss debuts on Netflix in December According to What’s on Netflix , the streamer will add both seasons of Sorry for Your Loss on Dec. 19. Olsen stars as Leigh Shaw, a young widow rebuilding her life after her husband Matt dies unexpectedly. His death changes her relationships and leads her to discover how much she never knew about him. Kelly Marie Tran plays Leigh’s sister Jules, Jovan Adepo portrays Danny, Mamoudou Athie appears as Matt and Janet McTeer plays their mother, Amy. Zack Robidas also stars. Kit Steinkellner created the drama, with James Ponsoldt, Azazel Jacobs and Rose Troche among its directors. Big Beach produced the Facebook Watch series. Executive producers included Steinkellner, Olsen, Ponsoldt, Lizzy Weiss, Robin Schwartz, Marc Turtletaub and Peter Saraf. The show earned strong reviews, with Rotten Tomatoes listing a 97% critics score and a 93% audience score across both seasons. Season 1 holds 94% with critics and 90% with viewers; Season 2 has a 100% critics score and 90% audience score. IMDb users rate it 7.3/10. The series impressed many with its unflinching take on grief, while Olsen’s acting also drew plenty of attention. Her performance landed a 2019 Critics’ Choice nomination for best actress in a drama series. The show also picked up a Shorty Award nomination in the Best Web Series category. Fans connected with the show’s raw take on loss and Olsen’s performance. She captured the isolation that comes with losing a life partner, prompting many fans to rank the role among her finest work. But the series ran out of road in January 2020. Facebook pulled the plug after two seasons as the platform moved away from scripted programming. title: LOTR: The Rings of Power’s Big Comeback Falls Short Despite Season 4 Renewal
summary: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power returned with Season 3 two years after the previous installment The post LOTR: The Rings of Power’s Big Comeback Falls Short Despite Season 4 Renewal appeared first on ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More .
content: Photo Credit - Prime Video The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power returned with Season 3 two years after the previous installment. However, it seems that the comeback after this long break has affected the show’s viewership. Following its November 11 premiere, The Rings of Power Season 3 drew significantly less viewing time than Season 2, which arrived in 2024. The new season generated 866 million viewing minutes on Prime Video. Approximately 70% of this total, around 606 million minutes, came from the first four episodes that premiered on November 11, 2026. According to The Hollywood Reporter , the 866 million minutes during premiere week are almost 15% fewer than the 1.02 billion minutes Season 2 garnered in its first week back in August 2024. Amid the decline in viewership, Season 3 has received generally positive reviews, with critics praising the performances, visuals, and tighter storytelling compared to previous seasons. However, some viewers have criticized the season’s pacing and its extensive use of lore. Sauron’s conquest will continue past Season 3 On Tuesday, Prime Video confirmed that The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power has been officially renewed for Season 4. The upcoming season is already in pre-production and will begin filming in Spring 2027 at Shepperton Studios in the U.K. Peter Friedlander, head of global television at Amazon MGM Studios, teased what lies ahead in the upcoming season. “The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power has become a defining series for Prime Video,” he said. “As season three delivers the landmark moment fans have been waiting for — the forging of the One Ring — we are proud to confirm season four with J.D. Payne, Patrick McKay and the entire creative team. We look forward to bringing fans even deeper into the rich world of Tolkien’s Second Age.” Similar to the first three seasons, showrunners J.D. Payne and Patrick McKay will be back to direct Season 4 as well. Originally reported on SuperHeroHype .
